verdict.rationale: Grok Build automatically saves every conversation to disk and lets you reopen past sessions with /resume, and it follows a user-written AGENTS.md in every session without being told. That gives developers cross-session continuity, but nothing shows the agent itself building or recalling a persistent memory automatically. Missing for 10: agent-authored persistent memory, automatic recall of prior-session learnings into new sessions, documentation of a memory feature, independent corroboration.
